claims.statement: Toolbar exposes a named toolbar region and uses shared ControlBase/Toggle controls for action semantics.
Arrow keys, Home, and End move focus among enabled items while disabled items are skipped.
Horizontal toolbars preserve item geometry and allow bounded overflow on narrow surfaces.

component.purpose: Group related actions into a responsive, keyboard-operable command surface.
component.title: Toolbar

states.description: A horizontal action toolbar is available.
Toolbar actions report their result without losing focus grammar.
The same item model adapts to a vertical surface.
